sv.title: Forskarnas lösning – så kan mobbning minskas
sv.summary: Forskare har länge studerat hur mobbning kan minska. Ändå uppger fler barn att de utsätts i skolan.

en.title: Researchers' solution – how bullying can be reduced
en.summary: Researchers have long studied how bullying can be reduced. Yet more children report being bullied at school.
